_meta.description: Heart event #2 for npc_kaydee: The Broken Tap

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: The main tap is busted AGAIN. Third time this month.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: If I have to pour from bottles all evening, someone's getting hurt.

options.text: I can build you a better one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [You repair the tap in twenty minutes]

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: ...You just fixed it. No fuss. No asking what's in it for you.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Most people want something when they help. What do you want?

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Fine. One free ale. ONE. Don't push your luck.
